sections.label: ✨ Improve
items: In String Theory's Network log (Ctrl+Alt+N), this script's rows now carry its own icon, the small table of its entries in Event Horizon's ⋯ menu, instead of String Theory's. It needs String Theory 2026.11.25.174628 or newer, which reads a script's icon from the shared browser storage (mbu.logIcons); this script writes its entry there once, on musicbrainz.org, when it first logs a request, and keeps every other script's entry. Like the log rows, only with "Share MusicBrainz's request budget with other userscripts (mbu:mb-gate)" on.
